W: Black stone. The door's thick. Nobody outside was meant to hear any of this.
f: A portrait of Kaldor, pointing east. The painter has made the finger very long.
T: A map of the eight kingdoms. The Mage Kingdom's border is inked in red, and the king's little carved soldiers are pushed right up against it.
Someone has stuck a dagger in the middle. Right through the mages' capital.

objects.name: General Vosk
lines: Close the door. This council does not meet.
The king says the army is for defence. Only defence. Five hundred years of only defence.
But the wizards are weak. Everyone says so. The French one says so. And an army that never marches is a waste of good bread.

objects.name: Marshal Grenna
lines: Every tithe fighter. Every champion. Every child on the Kaloseum's sand. Trained harder every year, for a hundred years.
You don't sharpen a sword for a hundred years to hang it on a wall.
When the king gives the word, we march on the Mage Kingdom. And if he doesn't...
* She looks at the empty chair at the head of the table, and doesn't finish.

objects.name: Scribe Tolm
lines: I write down everything this council says. Then I burn it. Orders.
Strength creates justice. The winners decide justice. I've written that four thousand times.
I'm starting to wonder who the winners are going to be.
